verdict.rationale: Fellow's REST API offers filtered, cursor-paginated list endpoints for recordings and action items, so many items can be read at once. Enterprise Super Admins can retrieve, export and delete data across the entire workspace. However, every documented write is single-item: marking one action item complete, archiving one action item, or a single find/replace in one note's agenda. True bulk mutations therefore require client-side scripting loops. Missing for 10: documented batch or bulk-update endpoints, bulk actions through the MCP server, bulk operations outside the Enterprise Super Admin tier, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
